name: toddler-read
description: A single‑page, tap‑friendly audio player for 2‑3 year olds.

scripts.android:sync: npm run reader:deps && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix generator ci && npm --prefix generator run build
scripts.build:netlify: npm --prefix generator ci && npm --prefix generator run build:web
scripts.android:install: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.adb:logs: $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb logcat -c && $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb logcat AndroidRuntime:E Capacitor:D chromium:E ToddlerReader:D '*:S'
